entities.summary: Johan Pieter "Jan Piet" Fokker was a field hockey player from the Netherlands. He competed at the 1964 and 1968 Summer Olympics, where his team finished in seventh and fifth place, respectively. In 1968 he was the team captain and scored two goals in eight games.
